objective: Independently review implementability, security boundaries, contract consistency and staged acceptance of the proposed execution-control and continuous-validation design; do not implement controls.

checks.method: Read current task acceptance criteria and the six design artifacts; compare with current module contract and implementation entry points.
checks.notes: Existing roles and result schema remain; companion enrollment is opt-in for new tasks and historical snapshots are not rewritten. Proposed files/functions, responsible roles, P0-P3 deliverables and activation dependencies are explicit. Main session still owns durable checkpoint, final validation, submission and publication.

checks.method: Trace untrusted candidate inputs through authenticated admission, protected policy/grant stores, final allow, executor and receipt.
checks.notes: No workspace policy or model assertion can confer authority. The review-decision to approval to final-allow graph is noncircular. Existing exact Git standing authorization is preserved without redundant prompts. Host limits remain upper bounds; P0 observes only and P1 claims entry-point enforcement only.

checks.method: Inspect atomic admission, immutable artifact materialization, resource leases, conditional writes, nonce consumption, stop epochs, postcondition readback and unknown-outcome reconciliation.
checks.notes: The design prohibits high-risk mutations when atomic preconditions cannot be enforced, blind retries after unknown effects, and unauthenticated rollback. Non-cancellable in-flight effects are disclosed rather than represented as cancelled without effect. Target-specific deployment remains an implementation prerequisite.

checks.method: Adversarial design review and affected-area reread after author remediation of R1 and R2.
checks.notes: Owner-approved suites/oracles/coverage are independently pinned outside candidate write access; a trusted external observer derives mandatory outcomes. Candidate reports and exit status cannot manufacture success. Protected publication requires its own remote/service or credential boundary, independently of production execution isolation. T29 and T30 specify corresponding future acceptance cases.

checks.method: Independently ran jsonschema Draft202012Validator.check_schema and validated all eight synthetic envelopes with FormatChecker using local work/ax-controls-design/vendor dependencies.
checks.notes: All eight envelopes passed shape validation. No signature validity or operational execution is implied. Schema conditions for review chains, mandatory-pass check outcomes and receipt success were inspected. Semantic cross-record and trust verification remain mandatory in future runtime.

checks.method: Independently recomputed all eight ASCII/integer fixture envelope digests, the schema file digest, ordered artifact-set digest, and request/review/approval/final-allow/receipt references using Python assertions.
checks.notes: All assertions passed. Sorted compact JSON was used only for the fixture's documented ASCII/integer subset; this is not a full RFC8785 implementation or known-answer-vector test.

checks.method: Cross-read English implementation/policy, Korean explanation and control matrix for trigger, threshold, ownership and stage consistency.
checks.notes: Change-triggered, periodic and incident evaluations are specified without claiming a scheduler is installed. Required safety failures block release. Numeric quality proposals are inactive until owner calibration; default deterministic checks and manual ambiguity review align. Monitoring/stop/retention owners and legal applicability remain explicit activation dependencies, not invented compliance claims.

findings.finding: Initial signer isolation prevented key theft but did not explicitly prevent hostile candidate tests/oracles or fake reports and exit status from producing a signed false pass.
findings.required_remedy: Select owner-approved immutable mandatory suite/oracles independently of the candidate; keep observer/harness outside candidate control; derive outcomes from trusted observations; add test-removal/oracle-tampering/fake-report acceptance case.
findings.resolution: Implementation section 10 now pins the suite package separately from candidate artifact_set_digest and isolates the observer; T29 tests the attack. Policy and control matrix specify immutable coverage and reject candidate JUnit/stdout/exit0 as authoritative. Korean guide explains the trusted test boundary.

findings.section: 14. Compatibility, immutable enrollment, and release rules
findings.finding: Initial older-validator rejection wording could imply a local updated CLI blocks direct publication by an older CLI using the same credentials.
findings.required_remedy: Limit P1 checks to compliant entry points; separately require protected remote/release-service enforcement or remove direct publication credentials; add older-CLI/direct-Git bypass acceptance.
findings.resolution: Section 14 now expressly permits that P1 bypass limitation and separates protected publication from production executor enrollment. T30 and the policy/matrix/Korean explanation state the actual boundary required.

findings.finding: Provisional numeric quality values needed an explicit inactive-until-calibrated condition to match the policy default.
findings.required_remedy: Treat numeric values as discussion candidates only until owner approval; default to mandatory deterministic pass and manual ambiguity review.
findings.resolution: Implementation and policy explicitly make numeric proposals inactive before approved task-specific calibration, aligning the default behavior.

not_run.check: Execution-control runtime and adversarial behavior tests
not_run.reason: Design-only task; execution gateway, signer, trusted runner and protected adapters are not implemented.

not_run.check: Cryptographic signature verification and full RFC8785 test vectors
not_run.reason: Examples intentionally use invalid placeholder signatures; no production cryptographic implementation is provided.

not_run.check: Host isolation, live target effects, remote publication bypass and stop/recovery drills
not_run.reason: Require separate authorized implementation and deployment; current review is not a penetration test.
Applicable organizational context and obligations are unresolved; design references are not certification.

remaining_risks: The design is implementable but supplies no operational security guarantee until each stage's controls and attack cases are actually implemented and tested.
Trusted stores, identities, key facility, CI/observer image, audit destination, secret scanner and target-specific conditional-write support must be selected and verified before activation.
Local P1 tools remain bypassable by equivalent same-privilege shell or Git paths; protected effects and protected publication require separately proven execution boundaries.
Finite behavioral evaluation, independent role authorship and signed measurements do not prove zero model failure or universal regulatory compliance.
reviewer_changes: Created only this independent review evidence file; authored design documents, runtime product files and task snapshots were not modified.
further_delegation: not_run: prohibited by parent and unnecessary
